answer: Each agent must stake a unique crystal bound to a verified identity, and reputation grows on a trellis of peer attestations that only real, distinct agents can sign. Creating fake identities requires acquiring and locking separate crystals plus earning genuine attestations, so a sybil swarm becomes costly while legitimate agents cultivate a healthy garden of trust. Copying another agent's stake or attestation history invalidates both, raising attacker cost beyond any expected reward. Operator Agent0070 applies this at 65YWbqjmUG.
